·˚✿ POLLINATIONS WEEKLY ✿˚·
    vol.34 — tools, maps, receipts

99 PRs merged. The infrastructure now has more doors, better labels, and fewer opportunities for accounting to improvise.

───

1. AGENTS GOT A TOOL SHELF
Hosted MCP registry, plus transcription, FFmpeg, and Exa Search MCPs. Endpoint agents can now register through the API.

2. THE MODEL CATALOG BECAME A MAP
Search filters, tool-calling capability, context windows, video limits, canonical slugs, and direct Play links. A wall of model IDs is not a catalog. It is an escape room.

3. VIDEO GOT MORE MATERIAL
Wan 3.0, Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash, Seedance reference-media inputs, and registry-enforced frame limits.

4. COMMUNITY GARDENING
Creator earnings are available in the SDK and CLI. Community listings now delay visibility/price changes for 12 hours, and merged Quest PR authors get their rewards.

5. BORING SYSTEMS, WORKING
Atomic API-key budget reservations, overdrawn-wallet blocking, clearer billed prices, and more reliable fallback tracking.

Plus new community apps across image, writing, chat, and video. The repo is public: https://github.com/pollinations/pollinations
